prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas of equal cells, ONLY BOTTOM LEFT contains one illustration, all other cells pure blank white. Attached image is STYLE ONLY: blue-charcoal ink outlines, pale watercolor, natural warm accents, white background. BOTTOM LEFT: a small clear kinship diagram illustrating nephew. Two adult bust portraits at the SAME top level: a young man on the LEFT, his adult sister on the RIGHT. A horizontal blue connector joins the two adult portraits to indicate siblings. Directly BELOW ONLY the woman's portrait, a thin vertical blue connector leads to her young SON, a smiling boy portrait in a small blue highlight circle. The man is the boy's uncle, the boy is his nephew. Exactly three portraits, two adults above and the boy below the sister, no extra family member. Leave generous white margin; every mark entirely within bottom-left cell, top of diagram below 56% canvas height. No text or letters or numbers, no captions, border, grid, logos, watermark.
review_notes: Viewed text-free three-node relation diagram: adult uncle and his sister at the same level, vertical connector only from sister to highlighted son below. All three portraits and lines lie within bottom-left cell. More explicit nephew relation than rejected generic family pose.
